track.title: Problem Solving
track.description: Classic warm-up algorithms written in Python.

topic.title: Warmup
topic.description: Array walks, ratios, patterns, and simple scans.

problems.title: List Total
problems.statement: You are given the length of a list and then the list values. Print the sum of all values.
problems.inputFormat:
First line: integer `n`.
Second line: `n` space-separated integers.
problems.constraints:
- 1 ≤ n ≤ 100
- Each value is between -1000 and 1000
problems.starterCode:
n = int(input())
vals = list(map(int, input().split()))
# print sum(vals)

problems.title: Sign Fractions
problems.statement:
Given `n` integers, compute three ratios among the full list length:

1. fraction of positive numbers
2. fraction of negative numbers
3. fraction of zeros

Print each ratio on its own line with exactly 6 digits after the decimal point.
problems.outputFormat: Three lines with floats printed to 6 decimal places.
problems.starterCode:
n = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# print three ratios with 6 decimals

problems.title: Right Align Steps
problems.statement:
Read an integer `n` and print a right-aligned staircase of height `n` using `#` characters.

Line `i` (1-indexed) has `n - i` spaces followed by `i` hashes.

problems.title: Min Plus Max
problems.statement: You are given five integers. Compute the sum of the smallest and the largest among them.
problems.inputFormat: One line with five space-separated integers.
problems.starterCode:
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
# print min + max

problems.title: Tallest Count
problems.statement: You blow out only the tallest candles on a cake. Given candle heights, print how many candles share the maximum height.
problems.inputFormat:
First line: `n`.
Second line: `n` positive integers (heights).
problems.outputFormat: One integer — count of tallest candles.
problems.starterCode:
n = int(input())
heights = list(map(int, input().split()))
# print count of max height
